correctness.rationale: For odd q and disjoint squarefree monic quartics with deg(φ1−φ2)=3, the fiber-product function field is degree four, giving a smooth genus-five normalization. Formal local factorization at each DISTINCT root ξ of h gives two branches at u=±sqrt(φ1(ξ)), v=∓sqrt(φ1(ξ)), with Frobenius exchange determined by χ(φ1(ξ)); the infinity tacnode has two rational normalization branches. Closed-point normalization factors yield (1−T)∏_O(1−ε_O T^{|O|}), even at repeated roots. Independently evaluated χ-point corrections at p=11,13,17,19,23 (0,−1,0,−1,−1); exact expansion gives h/4=3x³−32x²+110x−126 and discriminant −4460. The S3 splitting densities then follow by Chebotarev outside bad primes.
